description: This source file defines API endpoints for user profile management within a FastAPI application. It includes methods to retrieve the current user's display name based on authorization token and to look up a user's display name by their user ID from the 'public.profiles' table in Supabase. The code involves dependency injection, error handling, and interaction with external services such as Supabase.

classes.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the response containing user's display name and ID, along with the source of this data.

classes.name: GetDisplayNameRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for request payload to lookup a user's display name by user ID.

methods.name: SupabaseClient get_supabase(settings=Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Provides a Supabase client instance configured with URL and key from settings.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_current_user( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves the user ID from the Bearer token using Supabase authentication.

methods.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse get_me( supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to fetch the current authenticated user's display name, with fallback options.

methods.name: List[dict] get_display_name_by_id( payload: GetDisplayNameRequest, supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve display name for a given user ID from the public.profiles table.
